decision.observed_event: Your Fire Bolt hits the dealer. The dealer is hurt. Greasepaint runs and blisters on the burned faces, and the skin under it is ordinary, reddening skin. Roll initiative.

improv_read.connection: Uktarl is burned and his act melts with the paint.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit keeps the hit vivid and the call for initiative fast.

public_brief.objective: Survive the burn and send his crew at the caster.
public_brief.tactic: Reel back clutching his face and order the others to attack.
public_brief.visible_cue: Greasepaint blisters and runs on the dealer's burned face.
public_brief.reply_to: Whoever's still standing, I hit with Fire Bolt.
public_brief.kit_focus: Show the bolt landing and the paint running, then call initiative.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: keep the combat beat fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: A streak of fire cracks across the room and takes the dealer full in the face. He staggers back from the table with a howl, and his greasepaint runs and blisters; the skin under it is ordinary, reddening skin. The other three come up out of their chairs, scattering cards across the floor.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: My face, my face! Get him, you fools, get the rabbit, before he lights the rest of us up like tallow candles! Move! What do I feed you for, if not for this?
